newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Busang test cores to be analysed in Australia.
newsitem.headline: Busang test cores to be analysed in Australia.

text.p: Samples from independent drilling tests of Indonesia's controversial Busang gold property are likely to be flown to Australia for analysis by mid-April, industry sources said on Wednesday.

Results could possibly be available by the end of the month, they said. The sources, who declined to be identified, said Canadian consultancy Strathcona Mineral Services Ltd was drilling six test holes at Busang to determine the amount of gold there.
Canadian exploration firm Bre-X Minerals Ltd said last week there was a possibility that the amount of gold at Busang had been overstated.
It had earlier put gold reserves at some 71 million ounces, which would have made it the biggest find of the century.
Industry sources said Strathcona, hired by Bre-X two weeks ago to conduct an independent survey, had drilled several of six planned holes.
"All of the cores will be flown out of the country to a laboratory in Perth," one source said.
"The (drilling) programme should be finished by mid-April, and the cores flown together to Perth around 12 or 15 of April. Everyone is hoping for the results by the end of the month."
Industry sources said all parties associated with Busang were represented at the site, which was under "very heavy security guard".
The parties included Bre-X, the U.S. mining firm Freeport-McMoRan Copper and Gold Inc, the Indonesian partners and the Indonesian government.
The sources said Freeport-McMoRan, which had been selected to develop the property with a 15 percent stake, has been conducting a highly detailed due-dilligence survey of the property.
It had drilled seven test holes, four of which were drilled close to Bre-X drillings.
"All seven holes had insignificant quantities of gold," a source said.

The sources said a Bre-X office at Busang which had contained detailed logs and data on test drillings by the company had burned down some time between November and the end of February and the original records apparently lost.
